description: This file implements a driver for DES encryption using the Data Encryption Unit (DEU) hardware on a Linux kernel platform. It includes functions for setting keys, processing encryption/decryption requests, managing request queues, and handling hardware interactions for DES, 3DES, ECB, and CBC modes.

methods.name: lq_des_setkey
methods.description: Sets the DES key in the cryptographic context.

methods.name: lq_des3_ede_setkey
methods.description: Sets the 3DES EDE key in the cryptographic context.

methods.name: lq_deu_des_core
methods.description: Main interface to hardware for DES encryption/decryption.

methods.name: count_sgs
methods.description: Counts the number of scatterlist segments needed for total bytes.

methods.name: des_container_cast
methods.description: Casts an ablkcipher_request to a des_container structure.

methods.name: lq_sg_init
methods.description: Maps scatterlist entries to source/destination buffers.

methods.name: process_next_packet
methods.description: Processes the next packet in the encryption/decryption queue.

methods.name: des_crypto_thread
methods.description: Thread function that manages crypto requests and hardware interaction.

methods.name: lq_queue_mgr
methods.description: Queues DES requests and initiates hardware processing.
